purpose: The full-viewport loading overlay: a word, the brand mark, an 8-step spinner and four stacked photographs. Shown on / and on the 404 only.

alt.note: Required on every content image. Measured 3-27 words across the real images (longest: a 27-word hero carousel description); the four decorative preloader images ship alt="", which is why the empty string is allowed. alt is accessibility text, not visible page copy, so it carries its own budget but is excluded from contentMaxWordsTotal.

images.note: Exactly 4, each with a -p-500 srcset twin. z-index 9 on the second, 1 on the other three.

evidence.structure: Structure, layout and motion measured against the live original. A pixel audit verified 1382/1382 elements at a 1440px viewport and 962/962 at 390px with zero deltas. Copy is the original's own.
evidence.note: The 404's preloader is the same component; its evidence level is Structure and copy measured from the live original's own 404 page.

constraints.verification: Checked against all 5 real templates: where it is present (home, not-found) it is node index 0. src/layout/Layout.jsx:38 renders it before everything else.

motion.detail: html.is-loading hides every child (opacity 0, visibility hidden); src/loadSite.js:41 adds .is-loading, public/motion/m21.js runs a 1s counter, staggers the four images by 0.05 and clears the inline blur(20px) from the three layers.
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Show the final state immediately with no blur, no counter and no image stagger, then remove the overlay.
motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind: design-rule (the source ships NO prefers-reduced-motion handling for this section, so the fallback is prescribed by this repository, not mirrored)

responsive.base: fixed inset 0 at z-index 9999, pointer-events none

contentMaxWordsTotalNote: The only text field is `word` (maxWords 2), so a section-wide total could never reject anything the per-field budget allows. Declaring one would be a check that can never fire, so none is declared.
